name: smwgraphics-seifuku-densetsu-pretty-fighter-ending
title: Seifuku Densetsu Pretty Fighter - Ending
description:
The ending cutscene background from Seifuku Densetsu Pretty Fighter. A bit more colorful and detailed than the versus screen one. The kanjis in the background literally translate to "Pretty Fighter". Uses background autoscrolling like the original game.

A good fit for bonus rooms, in general.
